vo.en: Retailers make over three billion dollars every single year off unspent balances.

vo.en: It is a psychological exploit called breakage. When a card has three dollars left, your brain views it as worthless.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part: mega-corporations literally count on your brain forgetting those tiny leftover amounts.

vo.en: They pocket that extra change as pure profit without giving you anything in return.
